description: The tutorial editor window alone: the editor_* session commands (open a staged capture into a session, read its snapshot, execute a command, close the session, hide the window), the durable save/list/reopen commands (save a project, list every project on disk, reopen one by id) and the workspace view-preference commands (read/write the sanitized selection/playhead/panel-layout/theme blob, never the project's revision or history), the media-URL lookup (the absolute path of a REGISTERED asset or product only, for the preview), the waveform-peaks and thumbnail lookups over those same registered assets (derived by ffmpeg into the project's own cache), the media import job and its cancel/reconcile pair (editor_import_media opens its own native dialog; no frontend path is ever accepted), the caption import (editor_import_captions, likewise its own native dialog), the portable/lightweight project-file export and import (editor_export_package/editor_import_package, their own native save/open dialogs), the missing-media reconnect (editor_relink_media, its own native open dialog), the render job and the product ledger (editor_start_render, editor_get_products, editor_restore_product), the publication of a product into a vault (editor_publish_product, the tenth sanctioned vault write) the subtitle export (editor_export_subtitles, its own native save dialog) and the webcam take stream (editor_webcam_begin/append/finish/discard: MediaRecorder chunks as raw invoke bodies into the project's own takes folder) that build.rs's app manifest takes out of every other window's reach, plus the file dialogs its save/import flows need. No other capability grants any allow-editor-* permission.
